Understand the next step

What to know before you contact the team

Who this is for

New patients arriving from a campaign who need the exact approved offer terms before they act.

What to expect

  • Show eligibility, included services, restrictions, expiry, stacking, payment/insurance terms, and a contact route.
  • Give the office a named owner and expiry workflow before the page is linked from paid media.
  • Send a claim event only after an approved backend confirms the claim.

Limitations and boundaries

  • No price, reward, offer code, eligibility, expiration, or claim is active here.
  • A button click must never be counted as an offer claim success.
  • No `offer_claim` event or offer form is enabled without the approved terms and handler.

Questions patients ask

Before you decide

Can I claim an offer from this preview?

No. No public offer is configured and no claim is accepted in this local build.

Where will the terms come from?

The practice and compliance owners must provide the exact approved offer record and expiry owner.

When should `offer_claim` fire?

Only after an approved backend confirms a valid claim; never on a button click.
